en.text:
I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.

Each of my detonations release a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and burrows into nearby targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.

My Taken Seekers can stun <overload/>Overload Champions.

My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and <yellow Blighted Enemies (directly impacted by Witherhoard) /> take 100% increased tick damage.

I do not interact with <yellow Malfeasance /> or <yellow Wish-Ender />.

<bold/><yellow/> ▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟
